verdict.rationale: Autumn's closest native rule-to-action feature is configurable usage alerts, which fire when a threshold is reached; the changelog adds a `basis` field defining what 100% means. Webhooks fire on plan changes and are positioned for triggering workflows, but the user's own code must perform any action, so they don't count as a rules engine. There is no documented general-purpose way to define event→action rules inside Autumn. Missing for 10: a native rules/automation engine with configurable triggers and actions, documented action types beyond alerts, and hands-on or independent corroboration.
